text:
maria-partnerships: Heads up — starting coordination w/ LarkenAI on listing their L-20 family in AWS Marketplace + a HW SI bundle (EU-first launch). Need legal on redistribution/export, ops on residency, eng on hosting formats. looping @alex-legal @claudia-legal @sam-engineering @june-ops @ben-sales :wave:

alex-legal: Quick note — we need the original model license, source-of-truth for provenance, and a clarification on redistribution. If they want a downloadable quantized artifact on the marketplace we must add an addendum that limits redistribution and sets allowed geos. Also: export control questionnaire (EAR). Can they complete that by EOD Friday? :thinking_face:

sam-engineering: From infra side, options we can offer: hosted inference (Redwood Hosted), marketplace AMI/Marketplace container (bring-your-own-provision), or a downloadable weights bundle (S3 + checksum). For SI bundle we can include an INT8 quantized artifact and an install image for on-prem. Need hash, quantization recipe, and minimal test prompts. Prefer to avoid shipping raw FP32 weights for the hosted path.

june-ops: Ops constraints: EU region AMI requires our EU account image pipeline and signed provenance. For Dedicated/private deployments we'll need an install runbook and automated health-check container. Who will own the runbook? Also — if marketplace download is allowed, we need a gated delivery (license acceptance + export check).

ben-sales: Marketing asks: Larken wants a joint announcement and co-marketing budget. They prefer an April 15 launch window for EU customers. Sales/partners need a one-pager + win themes for SI partners. Can Partnerships own the launch cadence and speaker list?

claudia-legal: I can draft a marketplace addendum. Key items I want to include: non-redistribution clause for marketplace artifacts, explicit list of allowed geographies, indemnity language, export controls clause, and a provenance warranty (model origin + dataset provenance statement). I'll attach our standard marketplace addendum template and a quick export questionnaire for them to fill. Need a point of contact on Larken legal. :page_facing_up:

maria-partnerships: Thanks. Proposed immediate action items (keeping short):
```
- Larken: provide model license + provenance doc + export questionnaire (owner: Larken) — due Fri 5pm PT
- Claudia: draft marketplace addendum + send template to Larken (owner: claudia-legal) — due Mon EOD
- Sam: list hosting options + required artifacts (hashes, quant recipes, test prompts) and minimal AMI manifest (owner: sam-engineering) — due Mon 10am PT
- June: runbook template + gated download flow spec (owner: june-ops) — due Tue 12pm PT
- Ben/Mktg: one-pager draft + announcement cadence proposal (owner: ben-sales) — due Tue EOD
- Maria: create pre-announce invite list (partners, cloud PMs, SI leads) and track cadence (owner: maria-partnerships) — due Mon noon
```

alex-legal: Agree with that list. Also flag: if Larken's license uses a permissive clause allowing redistribution, we need a negotiated addendum that supersedes for marketplace distribution.

maria-partnerships: I'll ping Larken legal now and include the checklist above. I'll also create a short private pre-announce to AWS and our EU SI partners to reserve the co-sell date.

announce-bot: Deploy reminder scheduled: "partner-launch-checklist - check-in" on 1734506929 (in ~100s) — :bell:

ben-sales: Quick Q — do we want to include a pilot offer for a select set of enterprise customers (discounted Dedicated seats) during the first 30 days of the EU launch? If yes, I'll start drafting MSA amendments for pilots.

maria-partnerships: Yes, pilot sounds good. Ben, coordinate with Claudia for pilot MSA tweaks. We'll mark pilot customers in the pre-announce doc.

sam-engineering: One technical ask for Larken: try to produce a tiny reproducible eval set (5 prompts, expected outputs) so we can validate quantization/regression before publish. Ask them to attach a seed and tokenizer specs.

claudia-legal: Copying that — will include pilot MSA language & export checklist in the packet.

maria-partnerships: Perfect. I'll update this thread with the Larken reply and a link to the shared partner doc. Thanks everyone :rocket:
